text:
emma cho: Hi folks  New hire here, received a 2019 Intel MBP (16\") and trying to finish setup. Kandji got most profiles but FileVault is off and the machine asks for a local admin to enable it. Also there's an OS update to macOS 13.6 available; should I update before enrolling fully? Need to install gh, jq and a few brew casks.

ben - IT: Welcome @emma cho! For Intel machines we still enable FileVault during enrollment. We avoid major macOS upgrades until MDM has applied because system-level changes can stymie the escrow. So hold off on the 13.6 upgrade until we confirm enrollment and escrow.

it-help-bot: Opening ticket INC-2026-21987. Emma, can you run `sudo fdesetup status` and `profiles status -type enrollment` and paste outputs? Also provide the serial: `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | awk '/Serial/ {print $4}'`.

emma cho: Serial: FV1L2M3N4P5Q. `fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is Off." `profiles status` -> shows Kandji profile pending with UMS: "waiting for acceptance". Screenshot: <fv-off.png>.

rachel - devops: If the profile is pending acceptance, sometimes the user needs an admin to accept some kernel extension approvals (esp for Docker). We can grant a 90-minute temp admin session so you can accept and install Homebrew/Docker. @ben - IT can you approve?

ben - IT: Approved. Creating TempAccess session for "temp-emma" exp 90m. DMing creds. Note: session is audited and will expire automatically.

security-bot: Security reminder: Do NOT import private keys from personal machines. Generate a fresh SSH keypair with `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C \"emma.cho@redwood.com\"` and upload the pubkey via the onboarding form once done.

emma cho: Logged in with temp-emma, ran `profiles renew -type enrollment`. Kandji accepted and pushed the FileVault enable command. `sudo fdesetup status` now says "FileVault is On" and shows percent encrypted 0.1%.

it-help-bot: Marking INC-2026-21987 as in-progress; will auto-resolve when FileVault escrow shows as success in Kandji.

ben - IT: Quick FYI: for Intel MBPs with third-party kernel extensions we sometimes need to go to System Preferences > Security & Privacy to click "Allow" after installing the kext; the config will guide you. If you hit a grayed-out Allow button, reboot to Recovery and toggle the secure boot setting per the KB.

emma cho: One other thing: my Git credential manager prompts for SSO and fails until the device shows up in Okta Device Trust. How long after Kandji enrollment until Okta picks it up?

rachel - devops: Typically the Okta device sync runs within 5-10 minutes once Kandji finishes escrow. If it doesn't, file a follow-up and we can run a manual sync. Meanwhile, use `GIT_SSH_COMMAND` to point at your new ssh key for pushing.

emma cho: Uploaded pubkey to GitHub and submitted via onboarding form. Also generated a new gpg subkey for commits locally. Encryption at 3% now.

procurement-bot: FYI - device serial FV1L2M3N4P5Q matched procurement order PO-2026-889. Warranty and asset tag applied.

security-bot: Confirmed: FileVault escrow entry now present in Kandji for serial FV1L2M3N4P5Q. Closing note: keep the temp admin active only as needed; revoke if you no longer need it.

emma cho: All set, can install Docker and VS Code now. Thanks everyone! Will post a short intro in #general later :)
